FROM (SELECT [AMOUNT], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINETYPE], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_STLINE] UNION ALL SELECT [AMOUNT], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINETYPE], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE]) AS STLINE
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0

  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2026-02-01'

prompt: Ocak 2026 ürün bazında satılan adet nedir?
sql:
SELECT ITEMS.[NAME] AS urun, SUM(STLINE.[AMOUNT]) AS satilan_adet
FROM (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [AMOUNT], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_STLINE] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [AMOUNT], [CANCELLED], [DATE_], [LINETYPE], [STOCKREF], [TRCODE] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_STLINE]) AS STLINE
JOIN (SELECT '211' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [NAME] FROM [dbo].[LG_211_ITEMS] UNION ALL SELECT '411' AS [__nb_firm], [LOGICALREF], [NAME] FROM [dbo].[LG_411_ITEMS]) AS ITEMS ON STLINE.[STOCKREF] = ITEMS.[LOGICALREF] AND STLINE.[__nb_firm] = ITEMS.[__nb_firm]
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0
  AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS.[NAME]
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC

prompt: Ocak 2026 müşteri ve ürün bazında satılan adet nedir?
sql:
SELECT 
    cl."CODE" AS musteri_kodu,
    cl."DEFINITION_" AS musteri_unvani,
    it."CODE" AS stok_kodu,
    it."NAME" AS urun_adi,
    SUM(sl."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM dbo_LG_411_01_STLINE sl
JOIN dbo_LG_411_ITEMS it ON it."LOGICALREF" = sl."STOCKREF"
JOIN dbo_LG_411_CLCARD cl ON cl."LOGICALREF" = sl."CLIENTREF"
WHERE sl."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND sl."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND sl."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND sl."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01'
  AND sl."DATE_" < '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY 
    cl."CODE",
    cl."DEFINITION_",
    it."CODE",
    it."NAME"
ORDER BY 
    satilan_adet DESC

prompt: Şubat 2026 müşteri ve ürün bazında satılan adet nedir?
sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cl."CODE", ''), '(boş)') AS musteri_kodu,
    cl."DEFINITION_" AS musteri_unvan,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(it."CODE", ''), '(boş)') AS urun_kodu,
    it."NAME" AS urun_adi,
    SUM(sl."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM dbo_LG_411_01_STLINE sl
LEFT JOIN dbo_LG_411_CLCARD cl ON cl."LOGICALREF" = sl."CLIENTREF"
LEFT JOIN dbo_LG_411_ITEMS it ON it."LOGICALREF" = sl."STOCKREF"
WHERE sl."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND sl."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND sl."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND sl."DATE_" >= '2026-02-01'
  AND sl."DATE_" < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cl."CODE", ''), '(boş)'),
    cl."DEFINITION_",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(it."CODE", ''), '(boş)'),
    it."NAME"
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
